systems.owner: Office National de Protection des Réfugiés et des Apatrides (ONPRA), under the interior ministry, with UNHCR
systems.tiers: asylum seekers registered at ONPRA's head office in Bujumbura and, since February 2024, at the Cishemere and Makombe transit centres
fingerprint and iris enrolment of asylum seekers at registration; refugee identity cards (CIR) issued by ONPRA

note: UNHCR's asylum procedure page: registration and biometric enrolment of asylum seekers and refugees, an identity matter; nothing on the registration of births or deaths.
